lastResponse.text: Thank you for telling me that. I’m really glad you said it out loud. Because you had that thought last night and you’re still bleeding more postpartum, I want immediate help right now: call nine one one now, or tell shelter staff, “I need emergency medical and mental health help now.” If you feel even a little unsafe with your thoughts, treat it as an emergency. You are not alone in this. I can stay with you while you make that call.
